svg.text: 07 Mirror, lighting profiles and final doors
TV / MAKEUP CABINET v9 | build order | assembly / installation view
BEDROOM WORKSHOP | mm | verify stock and purchased hardware before cutting | revision 2026-11-15
All pictured panel IDs are listed in the native
BuildOrder sheet and CutSchedule. This is the
assembled module, not an exploded part detail.
1. Fit the mirror with compatible mirror fixing; fit profiles beside it and under TV Ledge.
2. Tall doors use half-overlay hinges; centre top doors use full-overlay as scheduled.
3. Fit site-cut ceiling/right scribes. Verify all doors and drawers open without rubbing.
4. The 630 mm chair armrests still exceed the 598.4 mm makeup drawer underside.
5. Test all LED branches and fit diffusers using the following wiring page.
